card.name: Dose and concentration text before a number or drug name
card.fires_on: Small joining spots in dosing and administration text: the % sign or the space before a number in a dose list, the start of a brand name in capitals, and 'and' in a list of salts. It fires just before a concentration, dose, or drug name continues.

modes.label: Before a dose number
modes.description: A space or comma just before the next number in a dose or concentration.

modes.label: Concentration or solution
modes.description: The % sign or the start of 'dextrose' in an IV solution strength.
modes.example: 300 to 500 mL/hr of 10<<%>> dextrose solution containing 10

modes.label: Start of a capitalized brand name
modes.description: The first letters of an all-caps brand name after a verb like 'Swallow' or 'in'.
modes.example: Swallow<< L>>YSODREN tablets whole; do not

card.writes: It does not clearly push any sensible output; it mildly suppresses the word 'powder' and its variants.
card.plain: It marks spots in dosing text where a number, solution, or brand name is about to continue.
